answer:
ArgoCD controllers (appcontroller, cache, application server) use SharedInformer for watching Application CRDs and cluster resources. Cert-manager controllers and informer factories use it for watching Certificates and Secrets. Prometheus Kubernetes discovery uses SharedInformer for watching Pods, Services, Nodes, Endpoints, and EndpointSlices. OpenTelemetry Operator target allocator uses it for watching collectors and Prometheus operator CRDs.

| argo-cd | `server/server.go` | Server uses NewSharedInformerFactoryWithOptions and WaitForCacheSync for watching resources |

| cert-manager | `pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go` | Informer factory creating SharedInformers for cert-manager CRDs |
